interpretation: Triggered cells (7/27, low-mask high-variance cells at rho=0.05) showed final-loss WORSE by mean +97% after LR halving. Not-triggered cells unchanged (sanity check). Threshold 10x in-training median triggered on sparse-signal cells where high gradient is legitimate (rho=0.05), not on instability. Halving LR there reduced effective learning. Max-grad signal is DIAGNOSTIC of instability (paper's 0.68 precision claim) but NOT a coupled-fix when used naively for LR-halving. A successful intervention must respect the legitimate-high-grad regime (low-mask sparse-signal cells) vs the instability-high-grad regime (high-mask rank-amplification corner).
schema: K15i max-grad-triggered LR-halving (threshold 10x median) on MDLM-OWT 130M
